description:
Generates a standalone GDPR Article 28 Data Processing Addendum (DPA) Markdown contract between a named Data Controller (client) and Data Processor (vendor/agency), incorporating Art. 28(3) processor obligations, Art. 32 technical security controls, governing law, and authorized sub-processors.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'generate_dpa' specifically for B2B vendor-client Data Processing Agreements (DPAs). Do NOT use 'generate_documents' for DPAs, as 'generate_documents' handles public website policies (Privacy, Terms, Cookies, EULA, AUP, Disclaimer, Return, Accessibility).

Preconditions & side effects: Requires non-empty 'controller_name' and 'processor_name'. Stateless and read-only—does not require or mutate any registered site.

Returns: JSON object with 'success', 'title', 'controller_name', 'processor_name', 'governing_law', 'sub_processors', 'markdown', 'word_count', and 'version' (or 'error').

controller_name.description: Legal entity name of the Data Controller (client organization).

governing_law.description: Governing jurisdiction for the DPA contract.

processor_name.description: Legal entity name of the Data Processor (agency or SaaS vendor).

sub_processors.description: List of authorized sub-processors covered by Controller's general written authorization.

name: generate_dpa

outputSchema.description: Generated GDPR Article 28 Data Processing Addendum contract.

controller_name.description: Legal name of the Data Controller.

error.description: Validation error message when success is false.

governing_law.description: Governing jurisdiction applied to the DPA.

markdown.description: Full GDPR Article 28 DPA agreement in Markdown format.

processor_name.description: Legal name of the Data Processor.

sub_processors.description: Authorized sub-processors enumerated in the DPA.

success.description: True if DPA contract generation succeeded; false if required parties were missing.

word_count.description: Total word count of the DPA contract.

title: Generate GDPR Article 28 DPA Contract
